parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-13, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1340.2 | 1.08 | 1.08
2 | 2148.3 | 1.38 | 2.46
3 | 5322.7 | 1.26 | 3.72
4 | 18475.7 | 0.33 | 4.05
5 | 19320.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AKH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-13, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Report: Station T-13 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-13 presents a 5-layer subsurface model characterized by continuously increasing resistivities with depth:
- **Layer 1:** 1340.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (0.00–1.08 m)
- **Layer 2:** 2148.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (1.08–2.46 m)
- **Layer 3:** 5322.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (2.46–3.72 m)
- **Layer 4:** 18475.7 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (3.72–4.05 m)
- **Layer 5:** 19320.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (basement)

Because resistivities increase monotonically ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$), all successive three-layer triplets (1-2-3, 2-3-4, and 3-4-5) satisfy the A-type condition ($\rho_a < \rho_b < \rho_c$). The true sounding profile is an **AAA-type** (or **A-type**) curve.

**Classification Discrepancy:** The archived classification of **AKH-type** does not match the interpreted model, as there are no intermediate resistive peaks (K) or conductive troughs (H).

{"curve_type_stated": "AKH", "label_issue_flagged": true}
